summary_1line: Bhishma explains which weapons suit different peoples and describes physical and temperamental signs that mark fearless, effective warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Fierce warriors with lion-like eyes and broad chests rush forward at the clash of drums and conch shells on a crowded battlefield.
A wild vanguard of rough, outlandish fighters with curled greenish hair and heavy necks charges recklessly toward the enemy line.
